name: Tokiwa Marina
source:
A seemingly cool older sister who dotes on the protagonist.

[url=/c62808]Yuu[/url]'s cousin. She is a beautiful and intelligent female college student. Her style is so outstanding that every man who passes by her looks back at her. She is actually a pervert who dotes on her cousin Yuu, but she cannot be honest and treats him with a cold attitude.
